# ci/cd: manage secrets for personal repositories by 1password

**Motivation:** org has transparent mechanics to define action secrets for all org's repositories, but personal accounts need this opportunity.

**Vision**

I have only one entry point to fetch secrets: https://developer.1password.com/docs/ci-cd/github-actions/ and reuse it in cases with similar repositories (copy-pasting workflows).
